facts.statement: Pisanosaurus was a small, ground-dwelling herbivore that could reach about 1 meter in length.
facts.quote: It was a small, lightly built, ground-dwelling herbivore, that could grow up to an estimated 1 m long.

facts.statement: The only known skeleton of Pisanosaurus was discovered in 1962 by Galileo Juan Scaglia.
facts.quote: Pisanosaurus is known from a single fragmented skeleton discovered in 1962 by Galileo Juan Scaglia

facts.statement: The genus name Pisanosaurus honors the Argentine paleontologist Juan Arnaldo Pisano.
facts.quote: The genus name Pisanosaurus means "Pisano's lizard" and combines "Pisano" in honor of Argentine paleontologist Juan Arnaldo Pisano

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus was formally described and named by Rodolfo Casamiquela in 1967.
facts.quote: Pisanosaurus was described and named by Argentine paleontologist Rodolfo Casamiquela in 1967.

facts.statement: Estimates based on the partial skeleton suggest Pisanosaurus was 1 to 1.3 meters long and weighed about 2 kilograms.
facts.quote: Based on the known fossil elements from a partial skeleton, Pisanosaurus was a small, lightly built dinosauriform, reaching 1 - 1.3 m in length and 2 kg in body mass.

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus possessed an open hip socket, a feature shared with many dinosaurs.
facts.quote: The acetabulum (hip socket) is open.

facts.statement: Only one species, Pisanosaurus mertii, is known from a single partial skeleton found in northwestern Argentina.
facts.quote: Only one species, the type, Pisanosaurus mertii, is known, based on a single partial skeleton discovered in the Ischigualasto Formation of the Ischigualasto-Villa Unión Basin in northwestern Argentina.

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus lived during the late Carnian stage of the Late Triassic, approximately 229 million years ago.
facts.quote: This part of the formation has been dated to the late Carnian, approximately 229 million years ago.

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus lived in a warm, humid environment with seasonal heavy rains and volcanic activity.
facts.quote: The Ischigualasto Formation was a volcanically active floodplain covered by forests, with a warm and humid climate, though subject to seasonal variations including strong rainfalls.

facts.statement: The diet of Pisanosaurus likely consisted of ferns, horsetails, and giant conifers.
facts.quote: Vegetation consisted of ferns, horsetails, and giant conifers, which formed highland forests along the banks of rivers.

facts.statement: It is hypothesized that the large carnivore Herrerasaurus may have preyed on Pisanosaurus.
facts.quote: The large carnivore Herrerasaurus may have fed upon Pisanosaurus.

facts.statement: The scientific classification of Pisanosaurus has been debated for over 40 years.
facts.quote: The exact classification of Pisanosaurus has been the topic of debate by scientists for over 40 years

facts.statement: Until 2017, the scientific consensus classified Pisanosaurus as the oldest known ornithischian dinosaur.
facts.quote: until 2017, the consensus was that Pisanosaurus is the oldest known ornithischian

facts.statement: Recent studies suggest Pisanosaurus might be a non-dinosaurian silesaurid, but this view has not reached a consensus.
facts.quote: More recently, some authors have begun to consider it a non-dinosaurian silesaurid, though this hypothesis has not reached a consensus either.

facts.statement: In 1991, Paul Sereno suggested that the Pisanosaurus fossil might be a chimera made of mixed bones.
facts.quote: it was even suggested by Paul Sereno in 1991 that the fossil is a chimera.

facts.statement: The classification of Pisanosaurus depends heavily on the debated evolutionary relationships of silesaurids.
facts.quote: The placement of Pisanosaurus is reliant on the placement of silesaurids as a whole, a situation which has invited much debate.

facts.statement: A 2008 study identified Pisanosaurus as the earliest and most primitive member of the ornithischian group.
facts.quote: A 2008 study placed Pisanosaurus outside of (and more basal than) Heterodontosauridae. In this study, Pisanosaurus is the earliest and most primitive ornithischian.

facts.statement: Two independent studies in 2017 concluded that Pisanosaurus was a silesaurid.
facts.quote: In 2017, two studies independently came to the conclusion that Pisanosaurus was a silesaurid

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus lived during the late Triassic period, between 228 and 216 million years ago in the Carnian stage, in what is now South America.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Triásico, hace 228 a 216 millones de años, durante el Carniense, en lo que hoy es Sudamérica.

facts.statement: The herbivorous dinosaur Pisanosaurus was described by Argentine paleontologist Rodolfo Casamiquela in 1967.
facts.quote: Este herbívoro fue descrito por el paleontólogo argentino Rodolfo Casamiquela en 1967.

facts.statement: The only known species, Pisanosaurus mertii, is known from a single partial skeleton.
facts.quote: La única especie y tipo, Pisanosaurus mertii, es conocida por un único esqueleto parcial.

facts.statement: Fossils of Pisanosaurus were discovered in the Ischigualasto Formation in the San Juan Province of Argentina.
facts.quote: Los fósiles fueron descubiertos en la Formación Ischigualasto en la Provincia de San Juan Argentina.

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus was a small, graceful dinosaur approximately 1 meter long and 30 centimeters tall.
facts.quote: Pisanosaurus fue un dinosaurio pequeño y grácil de aproximadamente 1 metro de largo y 30 centímetros de alto.

facts.statement: The estimated weight of Pisanosaurus ranged between 2.5 and 9 kilograms.
facts.quote: Su peso rondaría entre los 2,5 y 9 kilogramos.

facts.statement: The tail of Pisanosaurus is reconstructed to be as long as the rest of the body based on other early ornithischians, but this is speculative because the tail has not been recovered.
facts.quote: La cola del Pisanosaurus se ha reconstruido siendo tan larga como el resto del cuerpo, basándose en otros ornitisquios tempranos, pero como la cola no se ha recuperado, esto es especulativo.

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus was a bipedal animal that was likely herbivorous, like other known ornithischians.
facts.quote: Era bípedo y, como el resto de los ornitisquios conocidos, era probablemente herbívoro.

facts.statement: The genus name Pisanosaurus honors Argentine paleontologist Juan A. Pisano and combines it with the Greek word saurus meaning "lizard".
facts.quote: El nombre Pisanosaurus honra a Juan A. Pisano, otro paleontólogo argentino, junto a saurus que proviene del antiguo griego , que significa "lagarto".

facts.statement: The holotype specimen is designated PVL 2577 and was discovered in Ischigualasto.
facts.quote: El holotipo es un espécimen designado como PVL 2577, descubierto en Ischigualasto.

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus is known from a single fragmentary skeleton discovered in 1962 by Galileo Juan Scaglia at Agua de Las Catas in the Ischigualasto Formation, La Rioja, Argentina.
facts.quote: Pisanosaurus se conoce a partir de un único esqueleto fragmentado descubierto en 1962 por Galileo Juan Scaglia en la localidad de Agua de Las Catas en la Formación Ischigualasto, en La Rioja, Argentina.

facts.statement: The species name mertii honors the deceased Araucanian naturalist Carlos Merti.
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie honra al difunto naturalista araucano Carlos Merti.

facts.statement: The exact classification of Pisanosaurus has been a subject of debate among scientists for more than 40 years.
facts.quote: La clasificación exacta de Pisanosaurus ha sido tema de debate por parte de los científicos durante más de 40 años.

facts.statement: Until 2017, the consensus was that Pisanosaurus was the oldest known ornithischian, but more recently some researchers have begun to consider it a non-dinosaurian silesaurid.
facts.quote: Hasta 2017, el consenso era que Pisanosaurus es el ornitisquio más antiguo conocido, parte de un grupo diverso de dinosaurios que vivió durante casi todo el lapso de la Era Mesozoica, pero más recientemente, algunos han comenzado a considerarlo un silesáurido no dinosaurio.

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus was traditionally considered the most basal member of Ornithischia, though its postcranial remains appear to lack the synapomorphies of an ornithischian.
facts.quote: Pisanosaurus fue tradicionalmente considerado el miembro más basal de Ornithischia, los restos postcraneales parecen carecer de las sinapomorfías de un ornitisquio.

facts.statement: A 2008 study placed Pisanosaurus outside and therefore more basal than the family Heterodontosauridae.
facts.quote: En 2008 un estudio ubica a Pisanosaurus por fuera, y por lo tanto más basal, que Heterodontosauridae.

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus is the type genus of the family Pisanosauridae, which was erected by Casamiquela in the same work that named the genus.
facts.quote: Pisanosaurus es el género tipo de Pisanosauridae, una familia erigida por Casamiquela en el mismo trabajo que nombró a Pisanosaurus.

facts.statement: Over the years, Pisanosaurus has been classified as a heterodontosaurid, fabrosaurid, or hipsilophodontid, and has also been considered the first known ornithischian.
facts.quote: A lo largo de los años, Pisanosaurus ha sido clasificado como heterodontosáurido, fabrosáurido, hipsilofodóntido y también ha sido considerado el primer ornitisquio conocido.

facts.statement: In 2017, it was suggested again that Pisanosaurus was a silesaurid.
facts.quote: En 2017, se sugirió nuevamente que Pisanosaurus era un silesáurido.

facts.statement: A 2015 phylogenetic analysis by Agnolin recovered Pisanosaurus as a possible non-dinosaurian member of Dinosauriformes related to silesaurids.
facts.quote: Por el contrario, un análisis filogenético realizado por Agnolin en 2015 recuperó Pisanosaurus como un posible miembro no dinosaurio de Dinosauriformes relacionado con los silesáuridos.

facts.statement: In 2020, Rodrigo Temp Müller and Maurício Silva Garcia presented a hypothesis that "traditional silesaurids" should be interpreted as a group of clades representing a paraphyletic stem leading to traditional ornithischians.
facts.quote: En 2020 Rodrigo Temp Müller y Maurício Silva Garcia presentaron una hipótesis en que de los "silesáuridos tradicionales" se debía interpretar como un grupo de clados que representan un grupo troncal parafiletico que conduce a ornitisquios tradicionales.

facts.statement: The orientation of the pubis in Pisanosaurus is uncertain, with some skeletal reconstructions projecting it downward and forward in a propubic condition similar to most saurischian dinosaurs.
facts.quote: La orientación del pubis es incierta, con algunas reconstrucciones esqueléticas que lo proyectan hacia abajo y hacia adelante, condición propúbica, similar a la de la mayoría de los dinosaurios saurisquios.

facts.statement: The specimen PVL 2577 consists of a partial skull with a fragmentary right maxilla with teeth and an incomplete right mandibular ramus, lower jaw, six incomplete cervical vertebrae, seven incomplete dorsal vertebrae, molds of five sacral vertebrae, a rib, several rib fragments, a fragmentary right scapula, a coracoid, molds of a fragmentary ilion, ischium, and pubis, an impression of three metacarpals, the complete femur, right tibia, right fibula with an articulated astragalus and calcaneum, a tarsal element with a metatarsus, metatarsals III and IV, three phalanges of the third toe, and five phalanges including the ungual from the fourth toe, plus an indeterminate long bone fragment.
facts.quote: Se basa en una muestra con la designación PVL 2577, que consiste en un cráneo parcial con un maxilar derecho fragmentario con dientes y una rama mandibular derecha incompleta, mandíbula inferior, seis vértebras cervicales incompletas, siete vértebras dorsales incompletas, moldes de cinco vértebras sacras, una costilla y varios fragmentos de costillas, una escápula derecha fragmentaria , una coracoides, moldes de un ilion fragmentario ,isquion y hueso púbico, una impresión de tres metacarpianos, el fémur completo , la tibia derecha , el peroné derecho, con un astrágalo y calcáneo articulados , un elemento tarsal con un metatarso, metatarsos III y IV, tres falanges del tercer dedo y cinco falanges, entre ellas el ungual , desde el cuarto dedo del pie, y un fragmento de hueso largo indeterminado.

facts.statement: Fossils of Pisanosaurus were discovered in the "Agua de las Catas" locality within the Ischigualasto Formation in La Rioja, Argentina.
facts.quote: Los fósiles de Pisanosaurus fueron descubiertos en la localidad "Agua de las Catas" de la Formación Ischigualasto en La Rioja, Argentina.

facts.statement: The specimen was collected by José Fernando Bonaparte, Rafael Herbst, and preparers Martín Vince and Scaglia in 1962.
facts.quote: Este ejemplar fue recolectado por José Fernando Bonaparte, Rafael Herbst y los preparadores Martín Vince y Scaglia en 1962

facts.statement: Originally dated to the Middle Triassic, the formation is now believed to belong to the Carnian stage of the Late Triassic, deposited approximately 228 to 216.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Originalmente fechada en el Triásico Medio, se cree que esta formación pertenece ahora a la etapa Carniense del Triásico Tardío, depositada hace aproximadamente 228 a 216,5 millones de años.

facts.statement: The Ischigualasto Formation was a volcanically active alluvial plain covered by forests with a warm and humid climate.
facts.quote: La Formación Ischigualasto fue una llanura aluvial volcánicamente activa cubierta por bosques, con un clima cálido y húmedo

facts.statement: In 1993, Sereno noted that Pisanosaurus was found in close association with therapsids, rauisuchians, archosaurs, Saurosuchus, and the dinosaurs Herrerasaurus and Eoraptor.
facts.quote: Sereno en 1993 señaló que Pisanosaurus se encontró en "estrecha asociación" con terápsidos, rauisuquios, arcosaurios, Saurosuchus y los dinosaurios Herrerasaurus y Eoraptor

facts.statement: In 1976, Bonaparte hypothesized that Pisanosaurus played a role in a fauna dominated by therapsids.
facts.quote: Bonaparte en 1976 postuló que Pisanosaurus desempeñaba un papel en una fauna dominada por terápsidos.

facts.statement: The large carnivore Herrerasaurus may have fed on Pisanosaurus.
facts.quote: El gran carnívoro Herrerasaurus puede haberse alimentado de Pisanosaurus.

facts.statement: The parent group of Pisanosaurus is Parapredentata.
facts.quote: Parent group: Parapredentata

facts.statement: Pisanosaurus is classified in the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: The time range for Pisanosaurus is the Carnian stage, from 233.6 to 227.3 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Carnian (233.6 to 227.3 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The metacarpals of Pisanosaurus's hand appear elongated and measure about 15 millimeters.
rejected.quote: Los metacarpianos de la mano son aparentemente alargados y miden unos quince milímetros.
